components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Vermilion action with ink text; one per view.
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font-family: var(--font-body, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), box-shadow 240ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #e7eaee, 0 0 0 5px #1b3bff; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #ff3d1f; color: #0a0c12; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.35) inset, 0 10px 22px -14px rgb(255 61 31 / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(105deg, transparent 32%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5) 50%, transparent 68%); transform: translateX(-120%); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.35) inset, 0 16px 28px -14px rgb(255 61 31 / 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::after { transform: translateX(120%); transition: transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); }

components.name: Ghost Button

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; border: 1.5px solid rgb(10 12 18 / 0.28); color: #0a0c12; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #1b3bff; color: #1b3bff; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #e7eaee, 0 0 0 5px #1b3bff; }

components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid #ff3d1f; color: #c42a0f; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: rgb(255 61 31 / 0.12); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #e7eaee, 0 0 0 5px #1b3bff; }

components.css: .ds-banner { position: relative; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; display: grid; gap: 8px; align-content: end; min-height: 220px; padding: 32px 36px 44px; border-radius: 16px; background: #ffffff; color: #0a0c12; font-family: Archivo, 'Arial Narrow', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(10 12 18 / 0.05), 0 10px 28px -16px rgb(10 12 18 / 0.35), inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(10 12 18 / 0.14); } .ds-banner::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0 0 0 auto; z-index: -1; width: 54%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5b6272, #e1e5eb); filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05); mix-blend-mode: multiply; opacity: 0.5; -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, #000 55%); mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, #000 55%); } .ds-banner::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0 0; height: 16px; pointer-events: none; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #1b3bff 0 2px, transparent 2px 56px) left bottom / 100% 16px no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(27 59 255 / 0.55) 0 1px, transparent 1px 11.2px) left bottom / 100% 8px no-repeat; } .ds-banner__title { margin: 0; font-stretch: 62%; font-weight: 900; font-size: 88px; line-height: 0.86; letter-spacing: -0.015em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-banner__lead { margin: 0; max-width: 60ch; color: #434a59; font-weight: 500; font-stretch: 100%; }

components.css: .ds-tile { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr; width: 240px; min-height: 200px; border-radius: 16px; background: #ffffff; font-family: Archivo, 'Arial Narrow', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(10 12 18 / 0.05), 0 10px 28px -16px rgb(10 12 18 / 0.35), inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(10 12 18 / 0.14); transition: transform 360ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), box-shadow 360ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-tile:hover { transform: translateY(-5px) rotate(-0.5deg); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgb(10 12 18 / 0.06), 0 22px 48px -22px rgb(13 33 194 / 0.55), inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(10 12 18 / 0.14); } .ds-tile__band { position: relative; padding: 13px 18px 13px 44px; background: #1b3bff; color: #f6f8ff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tile__band::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 50%; width: 11px; height: 11px; margin-top: -5.5px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35); } .ds-tile__value { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; padding: 18px 18px 14px; border-top: 2px dashed rgb(10 12 18 / 0.28); font-stretch: 62%; font-weight: 900; font-size: 96px; line-height: 1; color: #0a0c12; } .ds-tile--ink .ds-tile__band { background: #0a0c12; color: #ffffff; }

narrative.overview:
FitMentor is dressed as a timed race, not a fitness dashboard. The ground is cool, matte Tyvek (the paper race bibs are printed on), ink fields carry the structure (the navigation rail, the mobile bottom bar, the home hero and the access field), race cobalt is the brand's data-and-selection colour (the active tab, bib bands, bars and lines, selected states, the form band, focus), and a single vermilion signal marks the moment to act, the live state, the personal best and the error. Numbers are the protagonists: set in Archivo pushed to its narrowest width and heaviest weight, they roll into place digit by digit like a split-flap board, and the week is read off a photo-finish strip of lanes with a timing ruler and a dashed finish line.

The surface is dense but legible at 1 to 2 metres: big condensed numerals, uppercase condensed headlines with tight leading, and a calm sans body at normal width. Materials are literal to the world: bib tiles with a colour band, two punched holes and a dashed tear line; a cobalt timing ruler along the bottom edge of page headers (on-ink on the hero); a perforated edge on the rail; grayscale photography, luminosity-blended into ink fields and multiplied faintly into paper headers. Dark theme is the same race at night: ink ground, a slightly lifted ink rail, same cobalt and vermilion, lifted text tones.

The world refuses the dark-neon fitness dashboard with a lime accent and glow. Light is the base theme; dark (chosen, or following the system) is the same world, never a different one.
keyCharacteristics: Tyvek ground, white bib surfaces, ink numerals.
Ink fields for structure (rail, bottom bar, hero, access); paper page headers.
Cobalt for data and selection only: active tab, bib bands, bars, lines, selected states, focus.
Vermilion is a signal, never decoration.
Archivo variable: width 62 to 68% for display and numerals, 100% for body.
Odometer digits on every number when data arrives.
Bib tiles, timing rulers and photo-finish lanes as the recurring geometry.

rules.name: The Ink Field Rule
rules.body: Structural regions (rail, bottom bar, home hero, access field) are ink, never cobalt; page headers are bib paper. Cobalt never floods a region.

rules.name: The Data and Selection Rule
rules.body: Cobalt marks what is measured or chosen: the active tab, a bib band, a bar or line, a selected control, the form band, focus. If an element is neither data nor selection, it is not cobalt.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Vermilion means act, live, best or error. If an element is none of those, it is not vermilion.

rules.name: The Bib Number Rule
rules.body: Every quantity is set in the condensed numeral voice (wdth 62, 900) and rolls in through the odometer. A number set in body type is unfinished.

rules.name: The Two Widths Rule
rules.body: Width carries hierarchy: 62 to 75% for display, numerals and titles, 100% for everything read as sentences. Don't invent intermediate body widths.

rules.name: The Paper Not Glass Rule
rules.body: Depth is paper on a table: soft drop plus hairline. Blur is reserved for overlays on camera and modals.

dos: Do build structural regions as ink fields (`rail-ink`) with on-ink text, and photo page headers as bib paper with a full-colour photo faded in from the right and a cobalt ruler.
Do reserve race cobalt for data and selection: active tab, bib bands (alternating with ink), bars and lines, selected states, the form band, focus.
Do set every quantity in Archivo at wdth 62 / 900 and roll it in through the odometer.
Do build new data containers as bib tiles: band, punched hole, dashed tear line, numeral.
Do keep vermilion for the primary action, live, personal best, finish and error.
Do use 2px-radius squares for bullets, dots and markers.
Do run entrances and hovers on transform and opacity (chart strokes may draw via dash offset), gate hovers behind `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`, and honour `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: Don't drift toward the dark-neon fitness dashboard: no lime, no neon glow, no separate night palette (dark keeps the same cobalt and vermilion).
Don't use vermilion as a decorative accent or second brand colour.
Don't set numbers in body width or regular weight.
Don't add a second accent hue; green is success only.
Don't flood a rail, bottom bar, hero, access field or page header with cobalt.
